Photos used by tests/test_server.py. They are copies of the reference photos as
they were on 2026-10-22 (the cropped strips of connectors 1 to 4), kept here so
the tests do not change when the photos in ../references are replaced.

Their part lists are frozen in test_server.py (FIXTURE_LISTS): they are what the
model read from these exact photos, not a statement of what is really in them.
